comment: save.c savegamestate():317-319 Sfo_spell(svs.spl_book[]) and restore.c restgamestate():708-710 Sfi_spell(svs.spl_book[]). An elven Wizard saves on her first turn. The second segment restores and lists her spells with '+', so spell.c dovspell() reads the restored svs.spl_book; the menu is then dismissed. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
